patches.reason: Legacy bug (creator report): helldate3.groovy sets block = "pantiesend" at the end of the first panties branch, but no case "pantiesend" exists and the switch has no default, so the while (!endReached) loop spun forever there (V2 explorer: TSR037). Evident intent: every other branch of helldate3 ends at "end1", which says goodbye and ends the script; the patch goes to "end1".

Legacy bug (creator report): the first date asks the player's hard limits and saves them as helldate.Limitpissy, helldate.LimitPissOral and helldate.LimitAnalY, but the third date reads helldate.limitpissy, helldate.limitpissoral and helldate.limitanaly. Legacy storage keys are case-sensitive (Java Properties), so the third date never saw a hard limit and could go on with what the player had ruled out. Read the keys the first date saves.

Legacy bug (creator report): the human-furniture scene of the third date goes on to humanfurniture22bf, a block that does not exist, for a player without an anal hard limit, so the date ended there; the anal part starts at humanfurniture22b. Its end, humanfurniture25, then took a player whose hard limit is swallowing piss into the toilet scene, the opposite of humanfurniture21's test of the same limit; test it as humanfurniture21 does. Unreachable before limit-keys and this patch, as no limit was ever read.
